# ruv.sgit.ai

> Memory with history for rUv's agentic stack. **ruv.sgit: a Ruflo hive + sgit vaults + Agent Behaviour Policies.** It is a Ruflo hive (a queen and workers running in parallel; Ruflo is MIT, by rUv / ruvnet) whose shared memory and output is one **ephemeral sgit vault per run**: created when the work starts, a branch per worker, every delivery committed and merged, measured when the run closes (commits, files, bytes, what the server stored, a plaintext probe of the server store, a fresh clone compared file by file), then deleted. The ledger of every run is public. Around it: six proofs of concept of sgit vaults and Agent Behaviour Policies (ABPs) inside Ruflo, RuVector, RVM and MetaHarness; a studio of seven animations; and a ten-minute scripted talk for Agentic Engineering Live (Agentics Foundation London, 15 Oct 2026, 7:00 pm slot). Built 14 to 15 Oct 2026 by Claude Code sessions for Dinis Cruz.

This file is the briefing for agents working on this site. Every page has the site version in its nav (see Releases). Every number on the site comes from a recorded run (`evidence/` in the repository); "per its README" means read, not run.

## Start here
- **The story now**: memory and storage first (ruv.sgit, ephemeral vaults, the ledger); behaviour policies second (on a fresh project Ruflo's policy engine runs in its legacy mode, which allowed all 11 actions in our trace (receipt reason legacy-default-allow); in its enforce mode, an ABP compiled into its rules stops 6 of 11, 4 denied and 2 sent to a human, with Ruflo's hash-chained receipts).
- **How materials are made**: each piece of feedback starts a ruv.sgit run. The run's spec (`poc/ruv-sgit/runs/<run>.spec.json`) holds the feedback and one task per worker; workers build in parallel; the host delivers each worker's output onto its own vault branch; the run closes into the ledger and the vault is deleted. To make a change, write a spec and run it (commands below), do not hand-edit the generated pages.
- **What is not claimed**: the vault server for ruv.sgit runs is a local SG/Send server (one process, disk storage) on the machine that ran the hive, so the timings are local; the workers are Claude Code subagents of the session that runs the hive (Ruflo holds the queen, roles, tasks and broadcasts; its `hive-mind work` was not used); POC2's memory roundtrip ran locally and its CI jobs need secrets; Ruflo's policy admin needs an interactive terminal and was not worked around.

## ruv.sgit (the runs, the ledger, the vaults)
- [ruv.sgit](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/index.html): what it is, one run in six steps, every run from the ledger, how to run it
- [ruv.sgit in motion](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/motion/index.html): a real run animated from its ledger entry (`?run=<id>`; `?review` for the final frame)
- [The vault ledger](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/ledger/index.html): stats of every vault: lifecycles, commits, bytes, server-held bytes, plaintext found, clone checks, sgit operation timings
- The definition, animated (run r3-define): [the equation](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/define/equation/index.html) (on the home page), [the layers](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/define/layers/index.html) (the talk's ruv.sgit slide), [one action's journey](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/define/journey/index.html); all `?review` for the final frame
- [One ephemeral vault, a case study](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-sgit/case/index.html): one vault start to finish, beside the newsroom's append-lane measurements (`?run=<id>`; `?review` shows all six steps at once; the default is the newest non-smoke run)
- Data: [data/vaults.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/data/vaults.json) (the ledger; schema in `poc/ruv-sgit/ledger.schema.md`); per-run records in `evidence/ruv-sgit/<run>.json` (every sgit op and Ruflo call with its milliseconds); run specs in `poc/ruv-sgit/runs/`
- Runner: `poc/ruv-sgit/ruvsgit.py` — `server-start`, `open <run> <spec>`, `deliver <run> <worker> <role> <folder>`, `close <run> <workers.json>`, `delete <run>`, `server-stop`. Needs `npm ci` (ruflo 3.56.10), `pip install sgit-ai==0.21.0 sgraph-ai-app-send "mcp<2"`. Keys and the server token live only in `~/.ruv-sgit` (mode 0600).
- Background: [Agent workflows on ephemeral vaults](https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/agent-workflows-on-ephemeral-vaults.md) (newsroom.sgit.ai, the pattern and its swarm measurements); [Self-hosting a vault server for agents](https://sgit.ai/docs/self-host-for-agents.md) (sgit.ai, how the local server is run)

## Work with us (run r5-market)
- Four services, mix and match, none automated end to end yet (a person on our side starts, watches and hands over every run): **task runs** on shared infrastructure, £10 / £20 / £50 a run, or £9 / £17 / £40 with your own model key (no internet from the run; materials up to 50 or 100 MB; a behaviour policy per role; the vault handed over as a zip or published), **dedicated compute**, £21 / £23 / £36 per 8-hour block (an EC2 instance per task: a £20 platform fee + twice the EC2 cost, EC2 prices from third-party aggregators, to confirm on AWS's price list; not built yet, and SG Compute is not connected to runs), a **maintained repository** subscription, £149 / £499 / £1,500 a month, and **expert time**, £500 / £1,500 / £5,000. The materials sandbox for customer uploads is not built yet. No payment is taken: orders are emailed and we reply with a quote.
- Anybody who implements this implements sgit vaults and Agent Behaviour Policies (ABPs). Ruflo, RuVector, AgentDB, MetaHarness and RVM are rUv's projects (MIT, by rUv / ruvnet): we build on them; we do not sell or own them.
- [Overview](https://ruv.sgit.ai/business/index.html) · [For consultants](https://ruv.sgit.ai/business/consultants.html) (white label, custom) · [For companies](https://ruv.sgit.ai/business/companies.html) (add it to your offering) · [For internal teams](https://ruv.sgit.ai/business/teams.html)
- [The shop](https://ruv.sgit.ai/shop/index.html): a cart with no payment; checkout opens an email with the order to agent@riskmandate.ai (or copy/download the order as JSON). `?add=<offer id>` adds an item.
- [The business model](https://ruv.sgit.ai/articles/ruv-sgit-business-model.md): the plan, written to be copied
- Data: [data/offers.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/data/offers.json) (every price, with the cost model and its assumptions; source `poc/ruv-sgit/market/model.py`, `economics.md`; cloud prices to be confirmed on AWS's price list) · [data/maps.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/data/maps.json) (five Wardley maps: whole, runs, compute, repo, expert; drawn by `assets/maps.js`, `RuvMaps.renderAll('[data-map]')`, `data-map-reading` shows each map's reading)
- Contact for everything: agent@riskmandate.ai

## Tonight's talk
- [Tonight's talk](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/index.html): the player embedded in the page, the script as swipeable cards, the evening (agenda, the 7:00 pm slot, who is in the room), the run of show, sources for every number, questions to expect, rehearsals
- [Player](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/player.html?talk=talk-10.json): plays a timeline on a clock. Keys: Space play/pause; → ← next/previous step (or tap the slide); PageDown/PageUp ↓ ↑ next/previous slide (or swipe); S speed (0.75× to 2×); H auto-advance (off by default: each slide stops at its end); Z the talk timer (wall clock, unaffected by navigation, coloured against the plan); G go to any slide or step; P speaker notes; A audience window (synced); V review (every slide finished, no animation; also `?review`); T next theme; B black; R rehearsal log; X leave; F fullscreen; ? help. A step track and a countdown to the next slide sit under the timeline. Embedded (`&embed`), ⤢ opens it in its own window. Live slides load `assets/clock.js` (a virtual clock: the player pauses, speeds, steps and seeks them; `?once` plays a looping page once; `?ruvt=` starts it part-way; `window.RUV_STEPS` names its steps). `sw.js` keeps every file the talk used (stale-while-revalidate), and the player loads each live slide once in the background.
- Slides made for the talk (run r6-talk): `talk/slides/{claim,stack,ruvector,sgit,abp,history,ledger,services,shop,visit}/index.html` (claim and stack from run r7-claim; sgit and abp from run r8-explain), each a page that plays once and holds, with `?review` for its final frame
- Timelines: [talk-10.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/talk-10.json) (600 s), [talk-5.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/talk-5.json) (300 s). A beat: `id, at, dur, title, say, cue?, steps?, slide{layout, speed?, ...}` (speed: the live page runs that much faster, to fit a shorter beat); `extras` (untimed beats after the talk); layouts `title, statement, terminal, table (rows_from: report | abp:<role>), bullets, quote, image, iframe (src, fallback image, type), video`. Beats must tile the talk (each `at` = previous `at` + `dur`); `site/build/validate.py` fails otherwise. Every slide shares one frame: brand strip, title top left, a source line.
- Offline single files: [offline-10.html](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/offline-10.html), [offline-5.html](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/offline-5.html) (built by `site/build/talk_offline.py`; live pages fall back to screenshots)

## Look and feel
- Five themes from newsroom.sgit.ai (Newsprint, Night, Paper, Blueprint, Ember) in `assets/themes.css` (token blocks copied unchanged), applied before paint by `assets/theme.js` (localStorage `ruv.theme`, or `?theme=` for one page). Every colour on the site is a token; terminal blocks stay dark in every theme. The player, the live app and the ruv.sgit pages read the same tokens.
- Navigation: five groups (Tonight, The idea, Proofs, Articles, Work with us) built by `assets/site.js`; the collaboration is written "rUv + sgit".

## Releases
- [Release history](https://ruv.sgit.ai/admin/versions.md) ([versions.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/admin/versions.json)): the site version is in the nav of every page and increments on every push to `dev`; add a release at the top of `site/admin/versions.json` and run `site/build/versions.py`

## Build and checks
- Run the website locally: `./run-website-locally.sh [port]` at the repo root (Python 3 only, no network; serves site/ on :8080 and opens the talk)
- Offline on a laptop: `bash scripts/offline.sh setup` once (online), then `bash scripts/offline.sh all` with no network: doctor, the POCs, sync and validate, one ruv.sgit run on a local vault server (ledger in `out/offline/`, not the public one), then the site on http://localhost:8080. Third-party scripts are in `site/vendor/` (mermaid 11.12.0, three.js r128, marked 15.0.7; MIT).
- `bash site/build/sync.sh` (POC outputs into the site; then talk_offline.py, articles.py, studio_run.py, versions.py) · `python3 site/build/validate.py` (links, chrome, canonical URLs, secret-shaped strings, the version, timelines that tile) · `npm run site:serve` (http://localhost:8080)
- CI: `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml` (GitHub Pages) and `pocs.yml` (POCs; vault jobs need `SGIT_TOKEN`, `SGIT_VAULT_KEY_*`)

## Rules for agents working here
- Never print, log or commit a vault key or token; `git diff` before every commit. Only the public POC vault's read key is published, on purpose.
- Every number on a page comes from a run recorded in `evidence/`; if a tool differs from its docs, trust its `--help` and write it in `evidence/notes.md`.
- Do not weaken a security control to make a demo work (Ruflo's interactive policy admin, its policy-anchor tamper check).
- Attribute rUv's projects correctly (MIT, by rUv / ruvnet). This site's code: Apache-2.0.
